entities.name: Dmitry of Tver
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dmitry Mikhailovich, nicknamed the Fearsome Eyes or the Terrible Eyes, was Prince of Tver from 1318 and Grand Prince of Vladimir from 1322 until his death in 1326, when he was executed in Sarai by the Mongols. He was a son of Mikhail of Tver and Anna of Kashin.
